description: Two similar-size far players plus a foreground walk-in; the pose primary-person selection flips targets mid-window (torso-anchor stickiness helps but a decisively larger walk-in still steals focus at ~4500ms and ~4900ms). 'The player's paddle/ball' becomes ill-defined; excluded from benchmarks.
regressionExpectation: Guided single-player capture framing avoids this; multi-player scenes need explicit subject locking before their metrics count.
